text:
maria_support: Heads up — we're seeing a sustained spike in 502/504s for the hosted inference API since 10:03 UTC, right after the canary roll of traffic-shard v3. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% -> ~6% in 8m. Affects multiple customers including acct-omega and partner-embed. I opened a ticket with their support leads.

maria_support: SLO alerted and we have p99 latencies climbing from 220ms -> 1.8s for generation endpoints. Lots of timeouts in the gateway logs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed: traffic-shard=v3 -> 10% @ 10:01:12 UTC (commit d4f9a3e).

kevin_runtime: I'm looking at runtime pods. A subset of canary hosts are getting overloaded — connection queues spike and model-load timeouts show in pod logs. Suspect the traffic-shard selector was mistagged so some routing rules are sending seed traffic disproportionately to 3 hosts.

jess_sre: Can you paste the gateway logs?

kevin_runtime: Gateway excerpt: ```
2026-03-18T10:04:05Z gateway-01 ERROR upstream request failed code=502 host=hosted-api-03 shard=shard-v3 msg="model load timeout after 3s"
2026-03-18T10:04:06Z gateway-01 WARN conn_queue_depth=102 host=hosted-api-03
```

maria_support: Repro steps from a customer: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b","input":"hello world"}' \n  -v
``` Returns 502 intermittently.

kevin_runtime: I repro locally against a canary instance — when batch window > 32ms the model loader gets starved and KV cache eviction spikes. Those three hosts have an older kernel selector label and ended up with too much seeded traffic.

raj_infra: I see in the rollout manifest the label for traffic-shard was set to `traffic=blue-v3` but the router policy expects `shard=blue`. That mismatch could have caused the mesh to route to the wrong subset.

maria_support: Which customers are impacted? Any billing anomalies?

luis_billing: Some failed requests are still getting counted in meter logs as billed calls because they hit the edge before failing — filing a billing investigation for acct-omega. We'll need to ensure refunds if they were charged for 502s.

tom_product: We rolled this to validate dynamic batching improvements — but we shouldn't have impacted production. Need rollback ASAP.

jess_sre: Agreed. Proposed immediate mitigation: remove traffic-shard flag and scale up canary hosts or pause traffic shift. Two options: toggle flag to previous or rollback rollout. Which is faster?

kevin_runtime: Toggling the flag is fastest. Command: ```
redwoodctl feature unset traffic-shard.v3 --env=prod
```
I'll prepare a rollback command as well if needed: ```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/hosted-api --to-revision=125
```

maria_support: @raj_infra can you run the flag unset and watch error rates? I'll notify affected customers.

raj_infra: Running now. `redwoodctl feature unset traffic-shard.v3 --env=prod` -> accepted, flag unset at 10:12:03 UTC.

deploy-bot: Feature toggle changed by raj_infra (traffic-shard.v3) at 2026-03-18T10:12:03Z.

jess_sre: Metrics update: error rate dropping from 6% -> 1.1% in last 60s. p99 latency falling back toward 300ms.

maria_support: Great. Can we confirm all customers see recovery?

luis_billing: acct-omega reports partial success post-toggle, but they saw ~18 failed calls billed. I'm flagging for refunds.

kevin_runtime: Root cause postmortem notes so far: deployment manifest had label mismatch `traffic=blue-v3` vs router expected `shard=blue`; combined with the kernel-selector label drift on three canary hosts led to disproportionate seeded traffic and model load timeouts under dynamic-batching settings.

tom_product: Let's schedule a quick patch: 1) validate manifest label schema in CI, 2) add router-side guard to ignore unexpected labels, 3) add canary distribution smoke tests that simulate burst.

jess_sre: I'll open an incident P1 postmortem and owner assignment. Also will coordinate with billing for customer refunds and send templated communication.

maria_support: Thanks everyone. I'll close the customer escalations once refunds confirmed and customers acknowledge. Follow-up actions: 
- kevin_runtime: add kernel-selector consistency check (owner)
- raj_infra: add manifest lint rule to CI
- tom_product: revert/v2 rollout plan with extra canary telemetry
- luis_billing: refund plan for acct-omega and partner-embed

maria_support: Final note — if anyone sees residual 502s after 10:25 UTC please ping this thread and @jess_sre oncall. :white_check_mark:
